build: cargo +1.97.1 build --locked --release --manifest-path crates/spiralcore-transfer/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-darwin --features hardware-sha256 --example codec_selection
host_limitations: Shared developer machine. Other labs are not stopped or reconfigured. No owned builds/tests/profiles run during measured collection. This is not a dedicated or thermally controlled benchmark host.

acceptance.ordering: deterministic cyclic rotation by (trial + case_index) modulo five; balanced positions, not randomized or fully carryover-balanced
gates: all successful seeds and targets exact after reopening
all 240 adaptive target-body counts equal minimum measured fixed-arm body count
predicted adaptive body count equals serialized actual body-equivalent count
all fixture identities and lengths match across paired arms

timing: Input-ready to sender return after verified durable publication, including all candidate encoders and serialization; excludes fixture construction, endpoint open/close, later reopen comparison, row writes, summaries and cleanup.
cpu: Process CPU includes sender and receiver in one serial process. Nested receiver and exchange times are subsets, never added to the total.
transport: Local serialized frames; no sockets, HTTP connection, TLS, relay or WAN. Reply-body equivalence includes sixteen metric bytes by defined size.
cache: Fresh per arm/trial; raw seed separately timed for every warm arm; receiver reopens between seed and transfer; optional DAG warming disabled equally.
statistics: Midpoint median; nearest-rank p95 (29th of 30); all raw observations retained; seed and seed-plus-target distributions separate.
failure_policy: Retain partial rows and failed operation cache; failed/partial campaign is incomplete evidence. Never replace an unfavorable measured trial.
cleanup: Remove only newly generated successful per-arm synthetic caches after exact reopen checks. Keep rows, failures, source identities and review evidence. Prior campaign artifacts and other labs untouched.
